aurum.settings.title: Aurum
aurum.settings.phase_note: Version %s. Most effects arrive in later phases; their settings are saved already.
aurum.preset.tooltip: Low holds 60 FPS on integrated graphics. High adds POM and a larger shadow map. Moving any single option switches to Custom.
aurum.option.sky_enabled.tooltip:
Replaces the vanilla sky with the golden-hour sky.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.sunset_intensity.tooltip:
How strong the orange band at dawn and dusk is.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.horizon_warmth.tooltip:
Warmth of the horizon glow toward the sun.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.rain_desaturation.tooltip:
How much rain pulls the sky toward grey.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.lighting_enabled.tooltip:
Sun light, sky ambient and warmed block light on terrain.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.sun_strength.tooltip:
Strength of direct sun and moon light.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.ambient_strength.tooltip:
Strength of the sky-tinted ambient light in shade.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.block_light_warmth.tooltip:
How warm torches and lamps look.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.ao_boost.tooltip:
Extra depth on top of vanilla smooth lighting.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.normals_enabled.tooltip:
Bump detail baked from block textures at load. One texture read per pixel.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.normal_strength.tooltip:
Depth of the generated bump detail.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.labpbr.tooltip:
Use _n and _s textures from a LabPBR resource pack when one is loaded.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.bounce_enabled.tooltip:
Tints shade and fog with the colour around you: warm in Badlands, blue on snow.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.bounce_strength.tooltip:
How strongly the surroundings colour the shade.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.bloom_enabled.tooltip:
Soft glow around the sun, lava and bright highlights. Medium and High.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.bloom_strength.tooltip:
Amount of bloom added back.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.sheen_enabled.tooltip:
Soft highlight on sand, terracotta, polished stone, ice and glass at low sun.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.sheen_strength.tooltip:
Brightness of the material sheen.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.shadows_enabled.tooltip:
Real shadows from the sun and moon. The most expensive effect.
§7Arrives in Phase 2.
aurum.option.shadow_resolution.tooltip:
Sharper shadows at higher sizes. 1024 on Low.
§7Arrives in Phase 2.
aurum.option.shadow_distance.tooltip:
Shadows are drawn this far around you, then fade.
§7Arrives in Phase 2.
aurum.option.shadow_softness.tooltip:
Width of the soft shadow edge.
§7Arrives in Phase 2.
aurum.option.entity_shadows.tooltip:
Real shadows for players and mobs within 16 blocks.
§7Arrives in Phase 2.
aurum.option.blob_shadows.tooltip:
Soft round shadow under mobs further away.
§7Arrives in Phase 2.
aurum.option.fog_enabled.tooltip:
Subtle fog that only appears at dawn, dusk, in rain, caves and swamps.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.fog_strength.tooltip:
Scales every kind of Aurum fog.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.height_fog.tooltip:
Low fog that settles in valleys.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.edge_fade.tooltip:
Light fade that hides the render distance edge.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.water_enabled.tooltip:
Gentle water with depth colour and sky reflections.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.water_reflections.tooltip:
Water reflects the real sky, sunset and clouds.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.wave_strength.tooltip:
Height of the small surface ripples.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.vertex_waves.tooltip:
Very small real waves near you. Medium and High.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.foam.tooltip:
Soft foam along shores and around blocks.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.puddles.tooltip:
Ground gets wet and puddles form in rain, then dry over minutes.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.ground_reflections.tooltip:
Sky reflection on smooth materials.
§7Arrives in Phase 3.
aurum.option.flare_enabled.tooltip:
Soft glow sprites from the sun, hidden behind terrain.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.flare_strength.tooltip:
Brightness of the lens flare.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.god_rays_enabled.tooltip:
Light shafts from the sun in haze.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.god_ray_strength.tooltip:
Brightness of the light shafts.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.clouds_enabled.tooltip:
Lit clouds with bright rims and shaded bellies.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.cloud_coverage.tooltip:
How much of the sky the clouds cover in clear weather.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.cloud_shading.tooltip:
Contrast between lit rims and dark bellies.
§7Arrives in Phase 4.
aurum.option.pom_enabled.tooltip:
Carved depth on blocks close to you. High tier only.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.pom_depth.tooltip:
How deep the carved detail looks.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.pom_distance.tooltip:
POM fades out past this distance.
§7Arrives in Phase 5.
aurum.option.tonemap.tooltip:
How bright colours are mapped to the screen. AgX Punchy is the Aurum look.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.saturation.tooltip:
Colour intensity of everything.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.vibrance.tooltip:
Boosts muted colours more than already strong ones.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.contrast.tooltip:
Difference between light and dark.
§7Arrives in Phase 1.
aurum.option.show_overlay.tooltip: Shows the GPU time of each render stage. Costs nothing when off. Key: F8.
